recipes.name: Lemon spaghetti
recipes.method: Boil the pasta. Warm sliced garlic in the oil, add zest and juice plus a splash of pasta water, toss with the pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, stir in the spices, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until just set.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
recipes.method: Stir everything but the banana together, leave in the fridge overnight, top with sliced banana in the morning.
